adds.title: Oklahoma Senate Bill 904 (2026) - Restriction on state resources for gender-affirming care
adds.summary: Signed May 14, 2026 and effective immediately, Oklahoma S.B. 904 prohibits use of public funds, Oklahoma Medicaid (SoonerCare) coverage or reimbursement, and state-owned properties and healthcare facilities for gender-affirming surgeries, puberty blockers, cross-sex hormones and other medications to delay puberty or develop secondary sex characteristics when affirming a gender identity different from sex assigned at birth for both minors and adults, with intentional violations by state employees punishable as a criminal misdemeanor and no penalties on patients. The ban exempts mental health counseling, anxiety and depression medications, precocious puberty treatment, intersex care, treatment of complications from prior gender-affirming care, and emergency treatment to prevent death or major impairment, leaving gender-affirming medical care available only at privately owned facilities paid by private insurance or out-of-pocket without Medicaid.

adds.title: Oklahoma sports ban - March 2022
adds.summary: In 2022 Oklahoma Governor Kevin Stitt signed S.B. 2 prohibiting transgender students from playing school sports consistent with their gender identity and excluding all transgender girls from school athletics, and signed S.B. 1100 eliminating inclusive non-binary gender markers from official documents.
